_comment: Registry edits for the OPERATOR to apply by hand to rules_sources.json (human-owned; the agent never edits it), then commit. Written by the reviews/24_rules_local_files change and validated only on a throwaway copy (tests/test_rules_local_files.py, RegistryPatchTests). How to apply: see 00_design.md 'Registry patch'. Every new local_file source ships enabled:false with '<OPERATOR: ...>' placeholders: the tool refuses an enabled local_file whose title, obtained_from, obtained_on or any section label/start/end is a placeholder, and treats a host whose terms_reviewed_by/on is a placeholder as unreviewed. Before enabling, drop the file into rules_inbox/ at the given path, fill the placeholders, and re-derive every start/end marker, label and column header from the actual file (the ones given are the mirror's and may not match official text).

www.zoneomics.com.note: Third-party mirror. Operator finding: the Terms of Use (last revised November 2020) bind every visitor 'whether or not you are a registered user' and prohibit using 'any robot, spider or other automatic device, process or means to access the Website for any purpose' and 'any manual process to monitor or copy any of the material on the Website'; the Subscription Service Agreement bans automated or non-automated scraping of Zoneomics Data. rules_scrape.py blocks this host in code (TERMS_BLOCKED_DOMAINS); review fields cannot lift the block. <OPERATOR SIGNS> if you want the review on record.

www.fultoncountyga.gov.terms_reviewed_by: <OPERATOR: your name, after checking the site yourself>
www.fultoncountyga.gov.note: Official Fulton County site (Zoning Resolution PDFs with a text layer). Terms review (proposed, NOT CHECKED BY THE AGENT): 'reviewed: no terms page found; public government document'. <OPERATOR SIGNS>: look for a footer 'Terms', 'Terms of Use', 'Disclaimer' or 'Site Policies' link first. Then replace both terms_reviewed_* placeholders; until then the tool treats the host as unreviewed.

www.unioncityga.gov.terms_reviewed_by: <OPERATOR: your name, after checking the site yourself>
www.unioncityga.gov.note: Official Union City site, behind Akamai (403 to the survey on 2026-11-05). Terms review (proposed, NOT CHECKED BY THE AGENT): 'reviewed: no terms page found; public government document'. <OPERATOR SIGNS>: look for a footer 'Terms', 'Disclaimer' or 'Site Policies' link (Granicus/OpenCities sites often carry one) and any Akamai bot policy first. Then replace both terms_reviewed_* placeholders; until then the tool treats the host as unreviewed.

gismaps.fultoncountyga.gov.terms_reviewed_by: <OPERATOR: your name, after checking the site yourself>
gismaps.fultoncountyga.gov.note: Fulton County GIS (PropertyMapViewer layer 34 zoning, used by zoning_import and the fc_layer34_zoning change signal). Terms review (proposed, NOT CHECKED BY THE AGENT): 'reviewed: no terms page found; public government document'. <OPERATOR SIGNS>: check the ArcGIS server's and fultoncountyga.gov's terms or disclaimer first. Then replace both terms_reviewed_* placeholders; until then the tool treats the host as unreviewed.

fairburn.note: Sec. 80-85 (f)-(g) and Sec. 80-86 (f)-(g). Starting point: the mirror's markers and labels. Official text may punctuate headings differently ('Sec. 80-85. - ...' in a Municode export); re-derive start/end and labels from the file before enabling. A PDF or text copy works with label_value when each label and its value sit on one line, separated by ':', a dash, a dot leader, or a run of two or more spaces or a tab (how pdftotext prints a two-column table). A value that wraps onto the next line is not read: the run reports 'label found, no separator or value after it on its line' and exits 4; use llm_prose or --assisted for that section.
